006package dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function;
007
008import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.IErrorCode;
009import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
010
011/**
012 * FOJS: Exceptions related to JSON function operations in XPath.
013 */
014public class JsonFunctionException
015    extends FunctionMetapathError {
016  @NonNull
017  private static final String PREFIX = "FOJS";
018  /**
019   * <a href=
020   * "https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#ERRFOJS0003">err:FOJS0003</a>:
021   * This error is raised if the input contains duplicate keys, when the chosen
022   * policy is to reject duplicates.
023   */
024  public static final int DUPLICATE_KEYS = 3;
025
026  /**
027   * <a href=
028   * "https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#ERRFOJS0005">err:FOJS0005</a>:
029   * This error is raised if the $options map contains an invalid entry.
030   */
031  public static final int INVALID_OPTION = 5;
032
033  /**
034   * the serial version UID.
035   */
036  private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
037
038  /**
039   * Constructs a new exception with the provided {@code code}, {@code message},
040   * and no cause.
041   *
042   * @param code
043   *          the error code value
044   * @param message
045   *          the exception message
046   */
047  public JsonFunctionException(int code, String message) {
048    super(IErrorCode.of(PREFIX, code), message);
049  }
050
051  /**
052   * Constructs a new exception with the provided {@code code}, {@code message},
053   * and {@code cause}.
054   *
055   * @param code
056   *          the error code value
057   * @param message
058   *          the exception message
059   * @param cause
060   *          the original exception cause
061   */
062  public JsonFunctionException(int code, String message, Throwable cause) {
063    super(IErrorCode.of(PREFIX, code), message, cause);
064  }
065
066  /**
067   * Constructs a new exception with the provided {@code code}, no message, and
068   * the {@code cause}.
069   *
070   * @param code
071   *          the error code value
072   * @param cause
073   *          the original exception cause
074   */
075  public JsonFunctionException(int code, Throwable cause) {
076    super(IErrorCode.of(PREFIX, code), cause);
077  }
078}
